# Nanowire_Network_Substrate

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A physical mesh of nanowires whose junction connectivity forms a complex network used as a neuromorphic computing substrate. Serves as a hardware platform for in-network neuromorphic computation, leveraging emergent network dynamics.
